newsitem.title: USA: SilverPlatter, KR SourceOne enter document pact.
newsitem.headline: SilverPlatter, KR SourceOne enter document pact.

text.p: SilverPlatter Information and Knight-Ridder Inc's KR SourceOne said on Thursday they have entered into an agreement to provide document delivery services to Internet subscribers of SilverPlatter Information's electronic databases.

As part of SilverPlatter's Internet Subscription Service, customers will have the option of electronically submitting orders for journal articles that are referenced in bibliographic citations, the companies said in a joint statement.
Subscribers may open an account with KR SourceOne for this service or they may choose to pay by credit card.
KR SourceOne is Knight Ridder's document delivery unit.
SilverPlatter Information provides electronic access to bibliographic and full-text databases using technology via local, intranet and Internet access.
